name: activate_stroke_protocol
description: Activate the acute stroke code protocol for time-critical stroke intervention including thrombolytic candidacy assessment

anticoagulant_use.description: Whether patient is on anticoagulation therapy

recent_surgery.description: Whether patient had recent surgery (contraindication for tPA)

when_to_use: Acute onset of focal neurological deficits suggestive of ischemic stroke
Patient within 4.5-hour window for IV thrombolytic therapy
Suspected large vessel occlusion for mechanical thrombectomy candidacy
Stroke alert from EMS or transferring facility

examples.query: Code stroke activated, 68yo with right-sided weakness and aphasia, last seen well 1 hour ago
Patient found with slurred speech on waking, unsure when symptoms started
